description: This Java source file defines the `SubscriptionFailed` class, which represents an event emitted when a search subscription fails. It includes methods for instantiation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for the error detail. The class extends a base event class and is part of an event-driven architecture within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.description: Represents an event indicating that a search subscription has failed, including details about the error.
